description: The page's contentinfo landmark in three bands. The product band holds the product name, a one-line description and a labelled navigation landmark with the site's pages. The Monark band holds the "built by" line, the Monark logo link (named by labels.monarkHome), the project and repo links, and a labelled list of icon-only social links. The legal band holds the copyright, the demo notice and the credits link.

keyboard.action: Moves through the page links, the Monark logo, the resource links, the social links and the legal links in visual order.

focus.notes: Every link shows the shared focus ring (ring-3 ring-ring/50). The "·" separators in the legal band are aria-hidden and never focusable.

announcements: The product links are announced as a navigation landmark named by labels.productNav ("Site pages").
Each social link is announced by its label, e.g. "Monark on GitHub"; the icon is aria-hidden.
The social links are a list named by labels.socials ("Monark on social media").
The Monark logo link is announced by labels.monarkHome ("Monark home page").
screenReader.notes: The default logo is MonarkLogo, the official horizontal logo with the wordmark outlined in the artwork (an SVG with role="img" and the title "Monark"); the link's aria-label replaces its name. A custom monarkLogo image needs no alt text of its own for the same reason.

contrast.text: Product name, page links and resource links in foreground; description, tagline and legal text in muted-foreground, which keeps 4.5:1 on secondary in light mode and on the background 5% darker in dark mode.
contrast.ui: Band borders are decorative. Social icons use foreground at 24px, above 3:1 on both band surfaces. The logo's wordmark is drawn in currentColor (foreground), so it keeps the brand kit's on-light / on-dark contrast.

motion.reducedMotion: No animation; hover only changes colour and underline.

consumerResponsibilities: Render one SiteFooter per page, outside <main>, so there is a single contentinfo landmark.
Translate labels (productNav, builtBy, monarkHome, tagline, socials), the social labels (map over MONARK_SOCIALS) and demoNotice.
Keep the visible "Demo · simulated data" notice while the site is a demo; drop it (demoNotice={null}) once the product is live.
Give any extra navigation passed as children its own aria-label (e.g. "The Monark DeFi family").
